## What and why

## Checklist (Definition of Done)

- [ ] Tests added or updated (property test where a law applies)
- [ ] Public items documented, doc example compiles
- [ ] New or changed units: `source`, `exactness`, derivation in `note`, cited golden vector
- [ ] No data copied from GNU units, rink or other GPL sources
- [ ] `cargo xtask validate-data` passes
- [ ] Benchmarks added or run when a hot path changed
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
